title: Gigabit and Ten-Gigabit Ethernet
markdown:
## Gigabit Ethernet

The need for an even higher data rate resulted in the design of the
**Gigabit Ethernet** protocol (1000 Mbps). The IEEE committee calls the
standard **802.3z**.

> **Note:** In the full-duplex mode of Gigabit Ethernet, there is no
> collision; the maximum length of the cable is determined by the
> signal attenuation in the cable.

### Topologies of Gigabit Ethernet

Four panels, extending the Fast Ethernet topology figure (13.19) with
two more configurations:

- **(a) Point-to-point**: two stations, one direct line.
- **(b) Star**: one **Switch** connecting down to three stations.
- **(c) Two stars**: two **Switch** boxes connected to each other by a
  horizontal line, each switch also connecting down to three stations
  (six stations total).
- **(d) Hierarchy of stars**: a top-level **Switch** connects down to
  two second-level **Switch** boxes (which are also connected to each
  other horizontally); each second-level switch connects down to three
  stations (six stations total, in a two-tier tree).

{{viz:0}}

### Gigabit Ethernet Implementations

| Characteristics | 1000Base-SX | 1000Base-LX | 1000Base-CX | 1000Base-T |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Media | Fiber short-wave | Fiber long-wave | STP | Cat 5 UTP |
| Number of wires | 2 | 2 | 2 | 4 |
| Maximum length | 550 m | 5000 m | 25 m | 100 m |
| Block encoding | 8B/10B | 8B/10B | 8B/10B | *(none)* |
| Line encoding | NRZ | NRZ | NRZ | 4D-PAM5 |

{{viz:1}}

### Encoding in Gigabit Ethernet

Two station-block diagrams:

- **1000Base-SX, 1000Base-LX, and 1000Base-CX** (share one diagram):
  8×125 Mbps lines feed a yellow **8B/10B block encoder** → 1.25 Gbps →
  a pink **NRZ line encoder** → out over **two fibers or two STPs**
  (symmetric decode path back).
- **1000Base-T**: a single-stage pink **4D-PAM5 encoder**/**decoder**
  pair, 8×125 Mbps in/out, fanning out to **4 UTP cables** with a mix
  of send/receive/bidirectional arrows.

{{viz:2}}

## Ten-Gigabit Ethernet

### Summary of Ten-Gigabit Ethernet implementations

| Characteristics | 10GBase-S | 10GBase-L | 10GBase-E |
|---|---|---|---|
| Media | Short-wave 850-nm multimode | Long-wave 1310-nm single mode | Extended 1550-nm single mode |
| Maximum length | 300 m | 10 km | 40 km |
